explanation: Pointing directly at a person with your index finger, especially a stranger in public, is seen as rude and confrontational in Brazil. Brazilians often gesture with an open hand instead, or point using their lips or chin toward a person or object, particularly when their hands are full.
local_tip: If you need to indicate a person, use an open hand rather than a single pointed finger — pointing at objects draws much less attention than pointing at people.

also_check.note: Pointing with a single finger is considered impolite; an open hand gesture is preferred.
Pointing with the index finger is common and generally acceptable, though seen as less polite in formal settings.
Pointing with the index finger is considered offensive; the thumb or an open hand is used instead.
